We're doing a lot of screening actions, a lot of flaring actions, just playing random ball sometimes. clips.video_title: Kevin Durant Postgame Interview vs Hawks
clips.pull_quote: we're doing a lot of screening actions, a lot of flaring actions, just playing random ball.

clips.speaker: Kevin Durant
clips.text: We got a good philosophy on the defensive side of the ball, whereas we know exactly how we're going to guard teams in each possession and then we all go in there and rebound. It's that simple. And then a lot of teams are also crashing as well. So when an offense crash, I think you get a little bit more opportunity to run out and get layups. So we got great passers, we got good runners, and last game against Atlanta was an emphasis that we didn't run out in transition as much as we could have, and this game we wanted to have a little bit more energy to get out on the break.
clips.news_angle: Kevin Durant on the team's transition offense philosophy

clips.pull_quote: we know exactly how we're going to guard teams in each possession and then we all go.

clips.speaker: Kevin Durant
clips.text: We've been working on this since training camp to the point where it's like we don't have to call that play, we just kind of know that all right, if we're sitting up there and nobody's moving, then flare or pin down or dribble handoff. So instead of sitting around, I think we're just moving around a little bit more and randomly moving around and that's throwing the defense off a bit. I think a lot of times when you call sets and they scout too, they know exactly what we're calling, exactly what these plays do. So when you can play random but also out of a concept of a screen down or pin down or dribble handoff, I think that just makes the game easier for you.
clips.news_angle: Kevin Durant on balancing set plays with random basketball
clips.social_post: Kevin Durant on the team's offensive evolution: When you can play random but also out of a concept of a screen down or pin down, I think that just makes the game easier for you.

This is a brotherhood, we compete at the highest level against each other and we keep that on the floor, but to see one of your brothers in this thing go down with such a gruesome injury, especially at this age and having an injury history last year, you know, just thinking about him, thinking about his teammates. That's tough to see, man. Like I said, it's a brotherhood, we want everybody healthy, we want everybody out on the court doing what they love to do.
